statements.text: When Nvidia trades at its all-time high on falling volume, the price rose in 80 % of 10 independent cases within 2 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Nvidia came back every time: in all 7 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 16 months at most.
After a fall of 30 % from its all-time high, Nvidia came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 16 months at most.
